data.description: Steve Wozniak's happiness formula reminds us that peace of mind is often worth more than winning an argument. His happiness habit encourages people to stop wasting energy on blame, complaints and pointless debates, and instead focus on their own mindset. By choosing inner calm over constant conflict, he believes it becomes much easier to live a happier, lighter and less stressful life. Read on to know how it feels relevant today.
